t: Communication From Italian Consulate General, Dated 22nd June, 1938

pages.en:
June 29 38.

CONFIDENTIAL.

Acting Consul-General for Italy,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No. 1215, Pos.A.48.a. dated June 22, 1938, in regard
to Miss Elena Zimmerman, and to state that there is
nothing to her detriment known to the Police. She
is the daughter of Vladimir Isayevich Zimmerman and
Sara Hersh Shmerkin who are stated to have been Soviet
citizens prior to 1929. Her father conducts an import
business at 215 Szechuen Road and enjoys a good reputation.

Miss Zimmerman was born at Gembloux, Belgium,
on 7th July, 1911. Some years later she went to Russia
with her parents and eventually to Vladivostock where
she remained until 1920 when the family came to Shanghai.
On completing her education at the Public School for
Girls, Yu Yuen Road, Miss Zimmerman entered her father's
business as an assistant and is still employed in this
position.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

（签名）

Sd: K. M. Bourne.
Commissioner of Police.

先生：

谨此提及阁下1938年6月22日第1215号、Pos.A.48.a号来函，事关埃琳娜·齐默尔曼小姐（Miss Elena Zimmerman），并告知警方并未掌握任何对其不利之记录。她是弗拉基米尔·伊萨耶维奇·齐默尔曼（Vladimir Isayevich Zimmerman）与萨拉·赫什·什梅尔金（Sara Hersh Shmerkin）之女；据称其父母在1929年之前均为苏联公民。其父在四川路215号经营进口业务，声誉良好。

齐默尔曼小姐于1911年7月7日出生于比利时让布卢（Gembloux）。数年后，她随父母前往俄国，最终抵达海参崴，并在那里居住至1920年，随后全家来到上海。在愚园路公立女校完成学业后，齐默尔曼小姐进入其父商行担任助理，目前仍任职于此。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

签署人：K. M. 伯恩（K. M. Bourne）
警务处处长。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
Section 1, Special Branch, Statistics,
REPORT
Date June 29, 19 38
Subject Communication from Italian Consulate General, dated 22nd June,
1938.
Made by D.S. Henchman Forwarded by W.L. gan 7/68

Enquiries from both Police and outside sources reveal
nothing detrimental to the character of Miss ELENA
ZIMMERMAN. She is the daughter of Vladimir Isayevich
Zimmerman and Sara Hersh Shmerkin; the father, who is of
Russian Jewish origin, conducts an import business at
215 Szechuen Road, there is nothing to show that he enjoys
other than a good reputation. Both parents are stated
to have been Soviet citizens prior to 1929.
Miss Zimmerman was born at Gembloux, Belgium, on 7th
July, 1911. Some years later, in company with her parents,
she went to Russia and eventually to Vladivostock where
she remained until 1920 when the family came to Shanghai.
On terminating her education at the Public School for
Girls, Yu Yuen Road, Miss Zimmerman entered her father's
business as assistant and in this position is still employed.

C. 29/6

D.S. Henchman
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch)

报告
日期：1938年6月29日
事由：意大利总领事馆1938年6月22日来函。
由 D.S. Henchman 撰写 由 W.L. gan 转呈 7/68

经向警方内部及外部来源查询，未发现任何有损埃琳娜·齐默尔曼小姐（MISS ELENA ZIMMERMAN）品行之记录。她是弗拉基米尔·伊萨耶维奇·齐默尔曼（Vladimir Isayevich Zimmerman）与萨拉·赫什·什梅尔金（Sara Hersh Shmerkin）之女；其父系俄裔犹太人，在四川路215号经营进口业务，现有记录显示其声誉良好，并无不良之处。据称其父母在1929年之前均为苏联公民。
齐默尔曼小姐于1911年7月7日出生于比利时让布卢（Gembloux）。数年后，她随父母前往俄国，最终抵达海参崴，并在那里居住至1920年，随后全家来到上海。在愚园路公立女校结束学业后，齐默尔曼小姐进入其父商行担任助理，目前仍任职于此。

C. 29/6

D.S. Henchman
D. S.

副督察（特务科）

CONSOLATO GENERALE D' ITALIA
SHANGHAI

No. 1215.
Pos. A. 48. a.

（印：POLICE S. C. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 0584 Date 24 6 38）

Shanghai, June 22nd, 1938 (XVI).

CONFIDENTIAL

The Commissioner of Police
Shanghai Municipal Council
LOCAL

Sir,

I should be much obliged if you would kindly furnish
me with all possible information concerning Miss Elena
ZIMMERMAN, residing in Shanghai, 391 Kiangse Road, her morals
and the reputation of her family.

This information is required by the Senior Officer
of the Italian Navy in the Far East with a view to securing
the necessary authorization for an Italian petty-officer to
contract marriage with the said Miss Elena Zimmerman.

Any information you may be able to supply will be
kept strictly confidential.

Thanking you in anticipation,

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient Servant,

（签名）

Acting Consul General for Italy.

上海公共租界工部局警务处处长
本地

先生：

如蒙惠赐关于居住在上海江西路391号的埃琳娜·齐默尔曼小姐（Miss Elena ZIMMERMAN）之一切可能信息，包括其品行及家庭声誉，本人将不胜感激。

此项信息系远东意大利海军高级军官所要求，旨在为一名意大利士官与上述埃琳娜·齐默尔曼小姐缔结婚约获取必要之授权。

阁下所提供之任何信息均将严格保密。

先此致谢，

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
